TGC Dynamic Collection Set Glossary
-----------------------------------
RegCnt   - Number of regions found in the age group
 AvgHis  - Historical average number of regions found in the age group
 AvgHxx  - Half-life average number of regions found in the age group for the last %zu iterations
ROR      - Rate of return when collecting (trace) the region set (amount of currently consumed data that is rendered reclaimable)
 RgCtB   - Region count before collection
  RgLfB  - Leaf region count before collection
 RgCtA   - Region count after collection
  RgLfA  - Leaf region count after collection
 RgOv    - Regions in an overflow state (uncollectable through normal means)
  RgLfOv - Leaf regions in an overflow state as a consequence of their parents being overflowed
 RcRgB   - Reclaimable region count before collection (those marked as part of the collection set)
  RcLfB  - Reclaimable leaf region count before collection
 RcRgA   - Reclaimable region count after collection
  RcLfA  - Reclaimable leaf region count after collection
 RcBcB   - Reclaimable region bytes consumed before collection
 RcBcA   - Reclaimable region bytes consumed after collection
